articles.summary:

 The post  თორნიკე რაზმაძე 3000 ლარით დააჯარიმეს — „მარგარიტა სიმონიანის შეურაცხყოფის საქმე“  appeared first on  Netgazeti .
articles.summary_en:
Judge Nino Enukidze fined activist and blogger Tornike Razmadze 3,000 GEL on the pretext of petty hooliganism, cursing in public space. It was the Ministry of Internal Affairs that demanded the maximum amount of the fine as a fine. The case concerns a comment published on the social network, which, according to Razmadze, was written in the address of Kremlin propagandist Margarita Simoniani. The comments were made by the Ministry of Internal Affairs and high-ranking officials of "Georgian Dream", both about Kobakhidze and the "Georgian Dream" government [...]

articles.title: EU member states wrangle over all-important budget: Is a deal this year feasible?
articles.summary: A marathon EU summit on October 15-16 failed to produce a breakthrough on the European Union's next long-term budget. Although EU leaders put on a brave face at the end of the talks by saying that "the way forward is clearer", EU capitals appear deadlocked on what that path is. At stake is the EU's ability to finance its strategic priorities from 2028 to 2034. The main dividing line is between the so-called "frugal countries", who want deep cuts to the proposed budget, and the "friends of cohesion", who say that cuts are not the answer.
